nodes.label: Case Detail UI – Status Tabs and Action Buttons (Generate Brief / Delete)
nodes.description: UI screenshot showing a case detail view with three status filter/tab pills (Engaged ✓, Declined, Closed) and two action buttons: a primary 'Generate brief' button (blue/purple gradient with a scales-of-justice icon) and a secondary 'Delete' button (with a trash icon). The layout suggests a legal or case-management application where cases can be marked with engagement status and a brief document can be auto-generated.
nodes.ui_purpose: Case management action bar for status filtering and brief generation
